format: LinkedIn copy-paste, bullet markers lost, plain headings, one culture heading followed by a blank line
note: 'About the job' is excluded vocabulary (R2.8.12); its text has no skills. Lost-bullet lines that are short and Title Case ('Proficiency in SolidWorks and GD&T', 'Robot Programming Experience') mention skills and have no colon, so they are body text (R2.8.7; rule 4 also fails). 'Life At Northfield' is followed by a blank line, so it is an unknown heading that ends Nice To Have: 3D Printing and Python there are culture text, unscored, never scored. Industrial Robotics evidence is the preferred line, not the earlier FANUC responsibilities line. Resume: robot programming is hypothetical; 'No experience with ANSYS or PLC programming' negates both (R2.8.5); 'no tool failures' and 'without exceeding air budgets' are not negations.
posting_text:
About the job
Northfield Robotics is hiring a Mechanical Engineer, Automation to join our Grand Rapids team.
Responsibilities
Design custom end-of-arm tooling and fixtures in SolidWorks
Specify pneumatics and vacuum grippers for end-of-arm tools
Support robot cell integration with our FANUC programmers
Create assembly drawings and BOMs in our ERP system
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field
2+ years of machine design experience
Proficiency in SolidWorks and GD&T
Experience with stress analysis of weldments
Nice To Have
Experience with ANSYS or other FEA tools
Knowledge of PLC programming is a plus
Robot Programming Experience
Life At Northfield

Monthly hackathons where engineers build 3D printing and Python side projects
Free snacks, 401(k), and an on-site gym
Northfield Robotics is an equal opportunity employer.
